name: Grilled Serepok catfish
summary: Red-tailed catfish from the Serepok, wrapped in a forest leaf, grilled over charcoal, and dipped in salt made with lemongrass, green chili, and forest leaves. Eat it with cơm lam in Krong No and Cu Jut, where the river runs.
origin: The Dak Nong tourism portal, 16 Mar 2022, and the 2024 visitor handbook. Both place the fish on the Serepok through Krong No and Cu Jut.
howToEat: Wrap the fish in a forest leaf and grill it over charcoal. The dip is salt made with lemongrass, green chili, and forest leaves. Eat it with cơm lam.
The same fish is also braised (om), made into chả, steamed, stir-fried with garlic, or cooked as cháo.
where: Krong No and Cu Jut, along the Serepok.
seoTitle: Ca lang nuong — grilled Serepok catfish
seoDescription: Red-tailed Serepok catfish in a forest leaf, with lemongrass-chili salt and cơm lam. Top 100 in 2020 and 2021.
